question: Section 131 of MV Act 1988 lays down the duties of the driver...
options: regarding the signal and signalling devices
regarding the precautions at unguarded railway level crossing
explanation: Section 131 deals with precautions at unguarded railway level crossings.

question: Maximum speed limit of an Ambulance ...
explanation: The maximum speed limit for ambulances is 60 km/hr.

question: Whether audio-visual equipments are permitted in any class of vehicle? if so, in which class...
explanation: Audio-visual equipment is permitted in contract carriages except A.B class.

question: Under which circumstance you will avoid overtaking...
options: when the visibility ahead is clear
explanation: Avoid overtaking on a curve as visibility is limited and it's dangerous.

question: Which type of parking is more suitable on wide roads...
explanation: Inclined (angular) parking is more suitable on wide roads.

question: When a pedestrian Steps in to a zebra line in front of you to cross the road...
options: stop before the stop line and treat it as a stop signal
you have to proceed before him
sound horn and speed up your vehicle to cross before him
explanation: Stop before the stop line when a pedestrian steps onto a zebra crossing.

question: Using mobile phone while driving can be punished with...
options: Disqualify from holding the driving licence (under CMVR 21/125)
explanation: Using mobile phone while driving can lead to disqualification from holding a driving licence. [Note: Under Section 184(c) of the amended MV Act 2019, using a handheld communications device while driving attracts a fine between Rs. 1,000/- and Rs. 5,000/- for the first offence]

question: While overtaking two wheelers, you should
options: Squeeze them on road to get more space
Leave as much room as you would for a car
explanation: Give two wheelers the same safe clearance as a car.

question: In which of these places you not park or wait?
options: In such a way that another parked car gets obstructed
explanation: Parking at a bus stop or blocking another parked car is not allowed.

question: What is the right hand lane used for on a three lane express way?
explanation: The right lane on multi-lane expressways is used for overtaking.

question: At a crossroad there are no signs or road markings. Two vehicles approach. Which has priority?
options: The vehicle on a widest road
Vehicle approaching from the right side
explanation: At an uncontrolled crossroad, give way to the vehicle on your right.

question: On which of these occasions must you stop your vehicle?
options: When signaled to do so by a police officer
explanation: You must stop after an accident and when directed by police.

question: When you are sure that it is not safe to reverse your vehicle you should
explanation: If reversing is unsafe, get out and check before moving.

question: When may you reverse from a side road into a main road?
options: Only if both roads are clear of traffic
Only if the main road is clear of traffic
explanation: Reversing from a side road into a main road is not permitted.

question: You are signaling to turn right in busy traffic. How would you confirm you intention safely?
explanation: An arm signal clearly confirms your intention to other drivers.

question: When traffic lights are out of order, what precaution should you take?
options: Stop, look right and left and proceed cautiously
explanation: Treat it like an uncontrolled junction: stop, look, and go when safe.

question: Why should you make sure that you have cancelled your indicators after turning?
options: To avoid misleading other road users
To avoid dazzling other road users
explanation: Canceling indicators prevents misleading other road users.

question: You are reversing. While reversing you should mainly look
options: In the right side view mirror
explanation: Look through the rear windscreen when reversing for the best view.

question: How much distance should you keep from a vehicle travelling in front of you?
options: Depends on the speed of the vehicle travelling in front of you
A distance sufficient to avoid collision if the vehicle in front of you suddenly slows down or stops
explanation: Keep a safe gap to avoid collision if the vehicle ahead stops suddenly.

question: What is the correct procedure if you want to stop on the left side of the road?
options: Apply brakes gradually after giving a signal for stopping
Check rear view mirror & look over shoulder and if it is safe to do so, give appropriate signal, slow down and stop on the left side of the road
Check rear view mirror, slow down and stop on the left side of the road.
explanation: Check mirrors and blind spot, signal, slow, and stop on the left safely.

question: Which is the best reason for not following other vehicles too closely?
options: To avoid getting dirt from wheel spray
To get increased angle of vision of traffic conditions ahead and to avoid hitting vehicle in front, if it stopped suddenly
explanation: A larger gap improves visibility and avoids rear-end collisions.

question: When approaching from the rear where two lanes of traffic have stopped at a signal, you should
options: Pass all the vehicles and stand in front of them
Pass between all the vehicles standing in the two lanes
Stop behind the last vehicle in appropriate lane
explanation: Stop behind the last vehicle in the correct lane.

question: A pedestrian is crossing the street at an intersection you should
options: Yield to pedestrian the right of way
explanation: Pedestrians have the right of way at intersections.

question: A bus at the bus stop signals the intent of moving off, you will
options: Flash lights and go past the bus
explanation: Give way to buses signaling to move off from a stop.

question: What does the temperature gauge indicate?
explanation: The temperature gauge shows the engine temperature.

question: What does an odometer show?
options: Total distance covered by the vehicle
explanation: An odometer measures the total distance traveled.

question: If you meet with an accident while driving a vehicle, without a valid driving license, the insurance company will
explanation: Driving without a valid license can void insurance coverage.

question: PUCC stands for
explanation: PUCC means Pollution Under Control Certificate.

question: Which of the following steps one should not take after an accident?
explanation: Do not give water to unconscious victims.

question: You arrive at the scene of an accident. What is the first thing you should do?
explanation: First secure the scene by warning other traffic.

question: Which age group of drivers is most likely to be involved in a road accident?
explanation: Young drivers (18 to 25) are most commonly involved in accidents.
